services.name: fishing charter
services.desc: Our custom fishing charters are based upon your preference. Whether you would like to fish for Salmon, Pacific Ling, Rockfish, Spot Prawns, crabs or a combination we can tailor a day just for you. We can accommodate a maximum of 8 people. For larger groups we can do separate charters. Departure is from the Madeira Park Govt dock. Getting here from Vancouver entails a ferry ride from Horseshoe Bay to Langdale. Drive north along Hwy 101 through Gibsons, Sechelt and on to Pender Harbour. Turn left into Madeira Park, through the village and then right to the Govt Dock. services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: The Gulf Rascal is a 34 foot, modern, aluminum vessel custom built by Norwest Aluminum Craft. She is spacious, fast, safe and well suited for a day of fun on the water. The large rear deck is open, mid deck under a roof and the cabin is cosy and warm. Powered by twin 330 hp Volvo diesels, and cruising at 30 knots, she quickly gets us to the fishing hotspots and safely back home. Equipped with radar, sounder, charting program, VHS radio and Transport Canada approved life jackets and safety equipment. Facilities include an board head (washroom) for your convenience. blurb: Guests join charters aboard the Gulf Rascal for sport fishing, spot prawn fishing, and eco-tours in the Sunshine Coast and Pender Harbour area. Fishing includes salmon, ling cod, flounders, rockfish, and spot prawns with hands-on experience pulling prawn traps. Eco-tours include scenic wildlife and bird-watching cruises in local straits and inlets.
